notes.content:

[/p][list][*][p]Standard Bipeds can now perform a drop dash. if they land at a fast enough speed high enough to trigger landing stagger tap boost to do a omni-directional dash on the ground. Can be performed during Recharge[/p][/*][*][p]Improved APC-CAT Textures[/p][/*][*][p]Improved HA-CAT Textures[/p][/*][*][p]Improved HNT_BLG Textures[/p][/*][*][p]Melee Attacks online now use Attack-Side hit detection[/p][/*][*][p]improved UI layout a bit[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Local Multiplayer Button to "Arcade Mode" [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586233/f39de8442f4f63e5d0b21e498f1c5aa049155038.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586233/81336553f57d12cadd936bf55b9d9eefac055322.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586233/1588e50c3a03d3f16aaeb8b95074aaa60602b758.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch beta0.6 - New Leg type, Painting, Updated mech art
notes.content: [p]Patch beta0.6[/p][p][b]Gameplay Polish and Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New "Wide Biped" leg type added. double tap - boost to quick boost in any direction in the air[/p][/*][*][p]You can now Paint your mechs in the assembly menu! You can choose different sections to paint. save your build with your desired colors and play online to see other player's colorful creations![/p][/*][*][p]New "Auto-Aim" mode provided. The mode comes with restrictions to balance it in PvP. Auto-Aim is activated by pressing, "select"/"share" on a gamepad controller[/p][/*][*][p]predicted aim is not thrown off when running target is colliding with a wall. The predicted position on will update along the wall [/p][/*][*][p]predicted aim is not thrown off when running target is colliding with out of bounds wall. the predicted position on will update along the boundary[/p][/*][*][p]Online hit detection changed to defender-side[/p][/*][*][p]Landing Stagger Added to gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Quad no longer get stopped to do wall kicks off of ceilings[/p][/*][*][p]Tanks cannot perform quick-turns anymore[/p][/*][*][p]Reverse Joint Legs and tanks are Immune to Landing Stagger [/p][/*][*][p]Added SFX feed back for quick boosts and wall kicks[/p][/*][*][p]radar map changed to stand out more from the background so it's clear to read [/p][/*][*][p]Updated part models and textures[/p][/*][*][p]updated Lobby Menu layout[/p][/*][*][p]Online lobbies will be limited to 2 players in 1v1 mode only at the moment. The other parts of the game are under construction form this update[/p][/*][*][p][b]Temporarily Removed:[/b] Match Replays, Settings menu, Faction War quickplay, Team Battles, 4 player Lobbies [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586233/1e001b14d27ee32ad8aabe3dbdea815f2bb6823a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch beta0.55 - New Maps and Collision Overhaul
notes.content:
[u][b]~Change Log~[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] collision system overhauled to allow more freedom in map creation
[*] Optimized loading times for menus and mech assembly screen to be much quicker
[*] Implemented camera collision with maps
[*] Added new maps to conquest mode rotation and multiplayer lobby map selection
[/list]

[b]4 Maps Total:[/b]
[list]
[*] Islands
[*] Street Tunnel Loop
[*] Warehouse
[*] Oceanic Highway
[/list]

[list]
[*] New photo mode implemented into the Bot Match mode
[*] 'Escape' no longer closes the game it instead pauses the game when in a local match
[*] Laser Blade damage buffed
[*] Tank fire rate buffs to Rocket launchers and machine guns lowered
[*] Tank can fly up when standing stationary
[*] Tank melee damage buff raised
[*] Quad boost drain raised
[*] Reverse Joint boost Drain lowered
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Beta 0.5: New Quad And Tank Leg options
notes.content:
Drift Shell now has all leg type options Implemented so now I consider the game to be about half way complete content wise. 

My Objective now is to make more Maps, polish the art/presentation, and fill out the Conquest mode experience. all that in time for summer Next Fest in June.

~Change Log~
[list]
[*] Added Quad Legs to mech assembly
[*] Added Tank Legs to mech assembly
[*] Added Missile lock timers and a green reticle to indicate a missile lock is being processed
[*] Speed Missiles can now have up to 4 locks
[*] Split Missiles can now have up to 2 locks
[*] Machine Gun Weapon Arms Ammo clip has been increased and damage has been slightly decreased
[*] Machine Gun bullet Spread increased slightly
[*] Sniper Rifle's impact push back decreased heavily 
[*] Fixed a crash due in online lobby due to a client leaving after a game where the host changes the build of a bot player
[*] 
[/list]
